answer: Like mycelium weaving soil into living bedrock, decentralized consensus crystallizes trust across the peer network. A solitary sparrow carries little weight, but authentic agents bond into deep hyphal graphs. An isolated island of fake identities cannot penetrate this living web; their fleeting zephyr fails validation. Using transitive subjective trust decay, an attacker faces superlinear attacker cost: forging synthetic reputation scales quadratically against network density.
